### CleanSpark Announces Participation in Upcoming Investor Events


November 6, 2026


- [Download (opens in new window)](https://s21.q4cdn.com/978676932/files/doc_news/CleanSpark-Announces-Participation-in-Upcoming-Investor-Events-2026.pdf)


LAS VEGAS


, Nov. 6, 2026


/PRNewswire/ -- CleanSpark, Inc. (Nasdaq: CLSK) ("CleanSpark" or the "Company"), a market-leading data center developer, today announced its participation in upcoming investor conferences. If applicable, live webcasts, replay information and updated presentations will be available on the Company's[investor relations](https://edge.prnewswire.com/c/link/?t=0&l=en&o=4816568-1&h=3958909445&u=https%3A%2F%2Finvestors.cleanspark.com%2F&a=investor+relations) page.

**About CleanSpark**
CleanSpark (Nasdaq: CLSK), is a market-leading data center developer with a proven track record of success. We control a portfolio of more than 1.8 GW of power, land, and data centers across the United States powered by globally competitive energy prices. Sitting at the intersection of Bitcoin


, energy, operational excellence, and capital stewardship, we optimize our infrastructure to deliver superior returns to our shareholders. Monetizing low-cost, high reliability energy by producing a global emerging critical resource – compute – positions us to prosper in an ever-changing world.
